title: Visit
description: Opening hours, how to find the shop on Quay Street, and how to reserve a book to collect.

sections.title: Visit the shop
sections.lead: On the quay between the ferry steps and the harbour master’s office, with the blue door.

end.heading: Getting here
items: Five minutes on foot from the ferry steps.

sections.title: Reserve a book to collect
sections.lead: Tell us the title; we keep it behind the counter for a week, or order it in within two days.
